lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice sequencing a short past story with simple time markers.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A colleague gives a very short recap of an evening or weekend day.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna tells Erik a short, simple story about a past evening or Saturday using först, sedan, and till slut, and Erik asks one easy follow-up.

main_focus.name: sequenced preterite with time markers
main_focus.description: Use simple sequencing words before past-tense clauses to order events.
model_examples: Till slut tittade vi på en film.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use sequencing words naturally 3-4 times with short preterite clauses.

vocabulary_target.theme: short story about a past day
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use sequence chunks to make a tiny past story easy to follow.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks about a past evening or Saturday.
dialogue_shape.middle: The other gives a three-step recap with sequencing words and short clauses.
dialogue_shape.ending: The listener reacts and asks or answers one simple follow-up.

target_complexity.repetition: use a clear three-part sequence rather than a long story

sentence_focus: one sentence beginning with efter det
one sentence beginning with till slut
one sentence summarizing that the day was good
